arStrings.szText: While inside {c_important}Consecration{/c}, you and your allies deal {c_number}[{SF_23} * 100|%x|]{/c} additional damage and consume {c_number}[{SF_24} * 100|%x|]{/c} less resource.

{c_important}Consecration's{/c} size is increased and lasts an additional {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} seconds. 

Enemies within {c_important}Consecration{/c} are now {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c}.
{c_important}Consecration{/c} Immobilizes enemies and can be cast anywhere.

{c_important}Consecration{/c} lasts {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} seconds, increasing its damage and Healing by {c_number}[{SF_13} * 100|%|]{/c} each second.

{c_important}Consecration{/c} detonates when it expires, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_BURST}{/c} damage to all enemies and Healing you and your allies for {c_number}[{SF_25} * 100|%|]{/c} of their Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * {SF_25})]){/c}.
